title: Enabling News Consumers to View and Understand Biased News Coverage: A Study on the Perception and Visualization of Media Bias
reasoning: The paper focuses on the visualization and perception of media bias in news coverage through a user study. While it discusses impartiality and fairness in journalism, and uses religion as a demographic variable, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary objective, nor does it address Large Language Models.
